semiconductor_relevance: High — Intertec Taiwan Corp. specializes in trading used semiconductor equipment and spare parts, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Intertec Taiwan Corp. has been a trader of used semiconductor, LED, and TFT-LCD equipment since 2001, focusing on providing cost-effective refurbished surplus equipment. They evaluate and purchase used equipment to meet customer demands efficiently.
capabilities: Refurbishment of Canon and Nikon Steppers
Sales of parts from Novellus, Speedfam, and Gasonics
Supply of Ebara and Edward pumps

regional_presence.Taiwan: Intertec Taiwan Corp. operates in Taiwan, focusing on the local semiconductor equipment market.
